gameDescriptionHtml:
Mahou Arms is an anime-inspired character-action hack and slash that tells the story of a magical girl paramilitary group fighting back against an unknown force invading Earth.

The human race is on the brink of total annihilation by the mysterious force known as the ‘Locks. GARDA, a global paramilitary organization, has finally discovered the means to fight back: magical girls.

Lead your small, ragtag group toward victory at all costs. Get to know your “soldiers” and take direct control on the battlefield to reclaim Earth. Good luck.

KEY FEATURES

  • Smooth Character Action Combat – Control a magical girl and fight with a variety of moves to take out your opponents!
  • A Gripping Story – Follow the struggle of GARDA and get to know the magical girls, along with a number of other characters!
  • Two Playable Magical Girls – Experience their unique movesets and playstyles!
  • Side Quests and Alternative Gameplay – Complete side quests and enjoy a variety of different mini-games (cyberspace battles, drone racing, and rail shooting)
  • Exciting Boss Battles – Fight unique bosses!
  • Spells and Skills to Unlock – Level up to become stronger and unlock unique abilities through the skill tree!
